立卡门：③ 维护者直派（ruling on #27506, comment 6499781492）。

## What this card is

Step 1 of the three-step ruling on #27506 (comment 6499781492): the ADR and spec-text amendment that the server step (#27506 itself) and the UI step depend on. Governed surface, Tier H: the maintainer merges.

The maintainer's words, verbatim and untranslated (card thread of #27506, 2026-10-29):

> 「我们的平台设计目标是 agent 和人类使用同一套系统」
> 「同意」

## Business reason

A `type: 'api'` action (Ban User, Impersonate, Set Password, 70-odd declarations on the platform's own objects) is today reachable only by a human click: the console fetches its `target` directly, and the platform action door and MCP `run_action` refuse the type (`isHeadlessInvokableAction` admits `script`, `flow` and `operation: 'update'` only). So an agent cannot do what a human can, and platform governance (the ADR-0126 switch, ADR-0066 D4, the anonymous baseline, audit) never sees the click. ADR-0066 D4's 2026-07 scope note records that gap as the rule; under the design goal above it is a gap, and Prime Directive #13 says a recorded decision is reversed by an ADR edit, never by a changeset.

## Scope (exactly this, no code)

- `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`, D4 "Scope of the server half": amend the api clause. New meaning: a `type: 'api'` action whose `target` is a same-origin platform path is dispatched by the platform action route and the MCP `run_action` bridge, which run the D4 gate before forwarding; the endpoint keeps re-checking its own authorization (defence in depth, not a replacement); an api action whose target is not same-origin stays browser-only and ungoverned, and the activation write door refuses to flip it. Keep the provenance of the 2026-07 note; add the amendment date and this card's ruling reference.
- `docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md` §8 item 2: one sentence recording that the action consult point covers `type: 'api'` through the same door (per §4 "each consumer documents its consult point").
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, `requiredPermissions` docblock and `.describe()` (around lines 1594-1606): reword to match; regenerate what `check:docs` reads (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated --fix`). No schema shape change. `Metadata-protocol: semantic` (the documented meaning of `type: 'api'` changes); `Clause-②: no`.
- No `scripts/adr-anchors` change unless the amended paragraph is anchored (check `pnpm check:adr-anchors`).

## Who acts

Authoring is open to any seat; landing is Tier H (maintainer merge or authorized approval). The card thread of #27506 can author the PR on request; otherwise the spec lane. Blocks: the landing of #27506's server PR (step 2). Does not block its development.
